It’s me (the idiot coworker). Most of this post is actually true. I’ve learned more from Jeff about programming in the past several weeks than I have in 2+ of years of coding on my own. I should be giving him about 30% of my salary. But on account of I have a wife, kid, and a hefty mortgage, I’ll hang onto the money for now. Besides, Jeff will be leaving our present employer sometime in the future and going on to make millions creating and selling awesome software that does such things as cure world hunger, eradicate liberalism, and aid in the creation of new forms of energy…and I’ll be left behind…writing unimportant (yet efficient) software b/c Jeff introduced me to the wonderful world of hashtables.

Thanks, buddy…and please post back to this space when you eliminate Ted Kennedy. I’ll buy you an HEB bowl.

/bc
